families.sourceDecisions: The source TooltipProvider wrapper defaults delay=0, while trigger/provider props can configure hover delay. disableHoverablePopup=false permits moving the pointer into the popup through the primitive safe-region logic. Disabled Root suppresses opening. Popup side=top, sideOffset=4, align=center, alignOffset=0. The package documentation calls tooltips visual-only and requires an appropriately named trigger; essential information uses inline text or an accessible Popover. This reference explicitly hides the redundant visual popup from assistive technology. Required help is persistent inline text; the trigger describedby relation points to that help, never solely to the visual popup.

referenceScope.definition: Complete means a sufficiently described source-bound reference contract for the selected family, not certification of all platforms or every product implementation.
referenceScope.sources: Pinned official shadcn Base UI React code/docs, Base UI 1.9.0 implementation/types/docs, native Figma visual source; explicit local design decisions fill composition-specific choices.
referenceScope.requiredChecks: Source/type/semantic/SCXML consistency, relevant positive/negative contract cases, editable render integrity and bounded representative React verification. Cross-platform adapters are supplementary and not completion gates.
